coding-agents.title: Coding agents: 11 small tasks and a must-fail control
coding-agents.about: Each CUJ is one message to a terminal coding agent in a fresh folder, then shell checks of what it left behind. Seven odd tasks where the obvious move is wrong, four plain ones, and a control that must fail. One run per CUJ.
coding-agents.subject: subjects/coding-agents
coding-agents.setup:
C=subjects/coding-agents/cujs
run() { for d in peculiar coding-agents; do michelin run subjects/coding-agents $C/$d/; done; }

peculiar-x2.title: Peculiar: 7 odd tasks, 2 runs each
peculiar-x2.about: The seven odd tasks from the coding-agents subject, run twice per CUJ. Pass rate counts runs.
peculiar-x2.subject: subjects/coding-agents

opencode-swe-lite-5.title: SWE-bench Lite, 5 easy pytest issues, in OpenCode
opencode-swe-lite-5.about: OpenCode on a local model fixes a real pytest issue. A pass means the saved patch resolves the issue on the benchmark's hidden tests, run on a clean checkout after judging (swe/hidden.sh).
opencode-swe-lite-5.subject: subjects/opencode
opencode-swe-lite-5.setup: # see subjects/opencode/README.md for prep.sh and hidden.sh
